title: Jinkx Monsoon crowned Queen of All Queens
summary: In the All Stars 7 finale (AS-S07-E12), the four queens with the most Legendary Legend Stars competed in a Lip Sync LaLaPaRuZa Smackdown for the Crown. Jinkx Monsoon beat Shea Couleé to Lady Gaga's "Judas" and then Monét X Change to Katy Perry's "Swish Swish", winning the season, the $200,000 charity prize, and the title Queen of All Queens.

title: All Winners season with charity prize
summary: All Stars 7 (All Winners) cast eight prior Drag Race franchise winners and directed the $200,000 grand prize to charity. Episode 11's variety extravaganza also tied weekly tips and a $30,000 lip-sync donation to contestants' chosen charities, underscoring the season's charity framing.

title: The Block replaces weekly eliminations
summary: All Stars 7 introduced The Block: no one was eliminated during the season. Each week two Top All Stars earned Legendary Legend Stars and lip-synced for a tip; the lip-sync winner could block one safe queen from earning a star the following week. After episode 10 RuPaul suspended further blocking. The four queens with the most stars advanced to the Queen of All Queens smackdown; the other four competed for Queen of She Done Already Done Had Herses ($50,000), won by Raja.
